Thank you!

Just wanted to say thank you to the reception staff. We had to call in twice this week, as emergency appt, and the reception staff were all friendly and very polite and kind.  They organised our appointments promptly, dealt with issue witj payment efficiently and kept. Us informed and happy. It really makes a difference. It is also nice to watch someone work and enjoy what they do, giving the job proper attention and knowing their job(we had to wait a little and heard them speak to other patients and nswerimg calls promptly). Its really nice to be looked after and cared for here, so thank you! Spevial praise to the petit lady with colourful tatoo on her arm. She's a great asset to your establishment!

Absolute joke from start to finish. I sent off a cat urine sample and told I would hear back same day as it was done in-house. 24hrs later and I had to chase them. Then the vet tells me we need to do another different urine test. Fine, I ask for an estimate of price. I've called to chase this twice and I'm still waiting days later. I call to chase again today and get told it can't be done today it will be tomorrow now. There is no urgency for anything. My cat could be seriously ill and its only getting worse the longer I have to wait and wait.
A lovely friendly practice from the front desk through to the vets, nurses and support staff. They were very caring and compassionate when looking after our elderly dog in her final few hours.

Big shout out to Lauren and Kirsten at Vets for Pets, South Shields Quays.  We were on holiday and my Shih-Poo, Marley, suffered a flap-cut on one of his pads.  Lauren and Kirsten went above and beyond their duties by pet-sitting, whilst I attended Wickes' public toilet next door, and had examined and diagnosed Marley as being safe and well, by the time I returned, offering extra advice to apply Vaseline to Marley's pads to rid their dryness.  They both gave super-efficient and friendly customer service throughout.

Oh, and the charge for all of that was zero!!!  They said, "We didn't do anything as Marley needed no treatment."

Thanks again,  Lauren and Kirsten!👏 👏

I honestly wouldn’t take my two cats, Waccoe and Badger, anywhere else! From the reception team to the nurses, everyone is always so kind, welcoming, and caring.

A huge thank you for fitting in our pregnant stray foster cat, Millie, for a last-minute appointment it was so appreciated. Emily has always been amazing with us she’s such a kind and compassionate soul.

And a special shout out to Dr. Mustafa for checking over our foster cat yesterday. We’re incredibly grateful for the care and kindness shown to all of our cats. We’re so lucky to have such a brilliant veterinary practice. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Professional, helpful, caring staff at this branch, looked after my previous rabbit Rupert who consequently lived to a great old age and when he passed away they sent me a sympathy card signed by the staff and a packet of daisy seeds to plant over his final resting place. Now I have a new rabbit and he was in for surgery yesterday, which was charged at the lower end of the price scale, given medicines with instructions and this morning someone rang to see how he had been in the night and how he was now, with advice as to how to proceed today, which is very thoughtful, plus he is booked in for two follow up appointments to monitor his progress, so all in all a very professional and comprehensive approach to the care of my rabbit. I cannot praise  the staff highly enough, they do a great job of looking after our pet's.

Charged £47 for eyedrops which are £8 at boots once realised within 10 minutes of leaving the practice that we had been ripped off, called and they wouldn’t refund. Losing trust in this vets which has been really good up to now, feels like they are just out to make extreme profit.
If you would like to contact the practice, to discuss your feedback further, please call us on 01132554466.
Always looked after my older cat Carlton well with his many and varied ailments and now the addition of his littler brother Albert too!

I cannot recommend Vets4Pets Bramley highly enough. From the moment you walk in, the entire team are warm, professional, and genuinely caring towards both pets and owners. They take the time to explain everything clearly, never make you feel rushed, and always go above and beyond to make sure your pet is comfortable and well looked after.

The vets, nurses and receptionists are absolutely brilliant — compassionate, knowledgeable, and incredibly reassuring during stressful times. You can tell they truly love animals and care deeply about the service they provide.

The practice is clean, welcoming, and very well organised, and every visit has been a positive experience. Thank you to the whole team for the amazing care and kindness you show every single time.
I can not recommend these guys enough. My cats are always well cared for and the staff are so friendly 😃 …
Excellent staff. Good knowledge. Friendly reception staff and really helpful!
Staff are all so kind and helpful
Thank you for your review.
Staff are great and never had a problem yet with them

I take my cat here and the vets are lovely. Today, I unfortunately had to bring in a cat that was dead in the middle of the road, and the vets that were there did a wonderful job of taking care of it.

Don't answer phone fir ages, then put me on hold for over 10 minutes. I gave up called back no answer.
Customer service is very poor.

Couldn't be happier with how Juno is cared for at Bramley Vets4Pets.  All the staff are great and show they really do care about  the pets they are caring for.

Been a regular user of bramley vets 4 pets for years just for regular apps.

On the 5th of February my almost 3 year old olde english bulldog (kaos) managed to get into some rat poisen.

The staff from receptionist to the nurses and the vets were absolutely amazing. And immediately went to work to save kaos pumping his stomach giving him a charcoal wash and lifesaving medication.

This was incredibly stressful for us but the staff were so fast even in the days after when we were contacting them to arrange meds and blood tests.

I can now report my dog has had the all clear and is back to being his usual self however we will certainly be keeping a closer eye on him.

But just a huge thankyou to all the staff who were all amazing. Thankyou for saving my dogs life.

Booked our cats Matcha and Burger for nails and vaccines, something happened with the system and they were only booked for vaccines but the amazing staff still were able to sort their nails just fine on short notice, Emily and the reception staff were brilliant!

Vet was so lovely at my kitty's microchip appointment today. He's a nervous boy and the vet was excellent with him. Also made sure I understood how to get his microchip registered and updated when I move in the near future.
We are sorry to receive a 1/5 rating. If you do wish to contact the surgery, we will gladly speak to you regarding your score and see how we can make changes or improvements. Nurse Helga
Very friendly staff

Excellent reception staff and vet. Had to say goodbye to our gorgeous bunny today and the staff were extremely compassionate, as was the vet who was not only highly professional and sincere, but also genuinely just lovely. I wouldn’t go anywhere else.
Thank you for the 5/5 rating. Nurse Helga
Great vets and usually very good,but can be hit and miss on any given day due to emergencies.

Me and my family would like to send some fabulous feedback to the team at Bramley vets 4 pets for there incredible care they showed us when we had to bring coco in for an emergency appointment recently. You guys were so understanding and caring and we will never forget this. You made the experience with coco unwell so much more easier. And thanks to your quick response she’s now on the mend and enjoying her food again.

Friendly and lovely staff. Always happy taking my pets here. Feel confident any questions I have will get answered. We recently had an incident where our cat was showing worrying signs. Within 15 mins from my call we were at the vets and treated. It turned out a chicken bone had wedged its self in the roof of her mouth. They were quick, Calm and reassuring and kept me at ease. I cant thank the staff enough.

Very helpful staff, I had to get my baby put to sleep and the staff were wonderful. Got us in straight away and we were able to spend as much time as we needed with her. Very Sensitive towards the situation. Thank you Vets4pets ❤️
Thank you for your feedback Ian
Best vet in this era very good stuff ❤️

My cat has been misdiagnosed four times now, fed up of paying for the vets mistakes. I inherited my cat from a deceased neighbour, he came with health problems, fed up of being treated like I'm a bad owner by a male vet, have some empathy man. I will not be giving this vet surgery any more of my time or money because of the male vet there. Absolutely useless. Is this man even qualified!?! Shame really, as the rest of the staff are lovely.
Took 2 cats there for a health check and to be micro chipped.Very friendly staff and an excellent service.Highly recommended 👍 …

I absolutely love Vet Emily. She diagnosed my Whippet with Congestive Heart Failure and we got to the Emergency Hospital in Birstall in time to save her. She has ongoing medication appointments and Emily’s love and advice is amazing.

I can’t recommend this team highly enough! From the moment we walked in, the team made us (and our pet) feel completely at ease. They are not only highly skilled and knowledgeable but also incredibly compassionate.
Despite Lilly not being registered Emily still took the time to explain everything clearly, answer all of our questions, and never rushed us. They treated our pet as if they were their own, which made all the difference.
If you’re looking for a vet who goes above and beyond, this is the place to go!

Took my cat, burger, here for an emergency, all staff involved were exceptional and caring, including the staff at reception, got him seen straight away and seen at the hospital very quick, all was fine. Went back in to pick up some worm treatment and they asked about how burger was, I'm glad the people here really care about the pets that come in, can't thank them enough

When I call, I am made to feel that Twigg is their only patient. .
When we are there, I am made to feel Twigg is their only patient.
When Emily, the vet, calls, she makes me feel that her only interest is Twigg. Nurse Helga is Twigg’s best friend. When I called this morning, Jodie went out of her way to ensure I got what I needed. Twigg is always so well looked after. I cant recommend putting your trust in Bramley Vet’s for Pet’s enough, as I have over the last 14 years. Thank you.

We have been using Bramley Vets for our pup for just over a year now and they have been great. The reception folks are super friendly, and the vets who have taken care of our wee furball have all been amazing, caring and able to provide great info when we have needed. I also had to contact them recently after witnessing a pregnant cat being abandoned and the team there were able to look after her and get her set up with a foster very quickly, great service and care shown all round. Thanks Vets for Pets Bramley!
Kind caring and helpful.

Useless doesn't come close. My dog has been having issues with his ears for years and been on steroids for about 6 years. Every time I want a repeat prescription they tell me he has to be seen by the vet, despite nothing ever changing and been prescribed the same meds again. All they care about is making money out of you and do not care about the animals welfare

We have been using this surgery for 10 years. After paying extortionate amounts for vaccinations and surgeries (after being quoted one price and having to pay treble) i paid and hired my best friend would be ok. Saturday 15th March my boy fell ill. I rang the surgery 3 times and finally got through at 4.34pm. To be told to go to Birstall surgery as they were closing at 5pm. We live less then 5 minutes from the surgery. If we'd been able to take him there our boy may have had a chance to be here still. Instead he died in the car on the 45 minute journey. I will not be using them again. Also he had his vet check in December which the vet failed to find any issues. Appalling service and staff turning you away in your hour of need.
Simba's pre snip and chip appointment
The young lady and young man so so knowledgeable.  15/03/2025. Helped me again with my puppy questions and choosing harness as he's very tiny  .
Lovely calm place to bring your pet.  Wonderful service and you know these great vets and staff genuinely care for the animals that come through their doors.
Very helpful and polite

It is with regret that I do not recommend this practice. Their record keeping is of serious concern, complaints are not taken seriously and the quality of care offered is a concern,  made worse by their appalling communication both internally and to patients. I've been with this practice for years but of late things seem to be getting progressively worse, all while the care for my pet has been inadequate. I don't want to place specific details so publicly, but I do want people to be aware that this practice has some serious issues. It's a shame as the reception staff are lovely and the reception has recently has some work done separating cat and dog areas more appropriately. I've had an ongoing issue with the practice for some time and there has been little concern from their side to deal with things for the sake of my pet, who ultimately is the one suffering not me. There also appears to be a high turnover of vets over the years and even in recent months. This practice has been the one I've always used and I will continue to use them but unless things improve we're going to be looking at some serious escalation to the parent brand and perhaps even beyond that.
Looks good after refit  staff friendly and knowledgeable, dog likes it too

Lovely vets with good parking. Moved from Southport branch and they did great job of my frenchies deformed nails.
Would recommend.
Fantastic service
